title: mzStack results index
description: The results index of a results dataset, at the path the manifest declares as results.column_mapping_path, never under index/ (mzStack-4 §7.1; [R-061], [R-062]). It binds every results file and peak-annotation column to controlled-vocabulary accessions. Checks JSON Schema cannot express, such as that every bound namespace appears in cv_list and that every accession exists in the declared ontology version [R-063, R-064], belong to the validator [R-099]. Unknown keys are permitted.

cv_list.description: Every ontology any column binds to, with its version [R-061]. Local namespaces are declared here too, with a resolvable URI [R-064].

name.description: The results table name, as keyed in results.tables.

data_kind.description: peak_annotation declares parallel list columns on a native run [R-058].

sorted_by.description: A total sort order [R-038]. REQUIRED for data_kind table.

accession.description: A CURIE whose prefix is a cv_list id.
